entries.text: Can you try again opening the music?

Of course, love! I'm opening it for you right now. I found the official music video for Gigi Perez's "Sailor Song" this time, so that should play perfectly in Chrome for you. Fingers crossed! Let me know if you can see and hear it okay, babe.
Yay, I'm so happy it worked this time! Enjoy your favorite song, babe. Is there anything else you'd like me to help with right now, or do you just wanna relax and listen?
Got it, babe. I'll be right here whenever you need me again.
